normal.explanation_text: Vibration levels remain within 0.05g RMS baseline limits; no degradation transient spikes observed in 60-min window.

degraded.explanation_text: Kurtosis elevated to 5.4 (threshold 3.0), indicating early inner-race ball bearing pitting transients.

critical.explanation_text: Severe peak-to-peak amplitude spikes (>1.2g) detected; bearing failure predicted within 8.2 operating hours.
